versions.changelog: Sync with mails v1.9.1: add stats, SSE events, mailbox management, webhook routing, cc/bcc/in_reply_to, send response shape, rate limit docs
Align docs with live API: remove broken /api/search, remove required to param, fix response shapes, update hosted URL to api.mails0.com
Expand OTP range to 4-12 chars, reposition as agent auth-completion infrastructure, add captcha limitation docs
Rewrite SKILL.md to remove curl examples that triggered security scan
Fix missing type parameter in extract API examples
Add email threading, auto labels (newsletter/notification/code/personal), and structured data extraction (orders, shipping, calendar, receipts)
Fix display name to Mails for Agent

- Renamed the skill from "email" to "Mails for Agent" in the name field.
- No functional or API changes; documentation has been updated to reflect the new name.

- Initial release of the email skill for sending and receiving emails via HTTP API.
- Supports signing up for services, entering verification codes, sending notifications or reports, searching emails, downloading attachments, and general inbox management.
- Requires environment variables: MAILS_API_URL, MAILS_AUTH_TOKEN, and MAILS_MAILBOX.
- Includes API endpoints for inbox listing, reading and deleting emails, waiting for verification codes, sending emails (with attachments), and checking health/status.
- Enforces that outgoing emails must use the configured MAILS_MAILBOX as the sender.
